title: Shyness, clinging, or fear with unfamiliar people
summary: By about 9 months, most children are shy, clingy, or fearful around strangers, the milestone sheet says.
body: Any of those three reactions meets the way sheet writes the line. A child can clutch, or go quiet, or glance afraid, and still fit the item as the page states it. The reaction is to someone unfamiliar. The sheet's cutoff is most children, set at 75 percent or more, and it is not a tool that diagnoses anxiety. Caregivers with a worry are told to chatting with a doctor.
